title: CSS design system tokens: standardise spacing, typography, and colour to one consistent unit system
goal: CSS audit scored 4/10 due to mixing px and rem units, inconsistent spacing values, and duplicate CSS variable definitions. This causes visual inconsistency and makes future changes expensive. Fix in one focused pass: (1) Audit styles.css for all spacing values (padding, margin, gap) and standardise to rem with a 4px base grid: 0.25rem (4px), 0.5rem (8px), 0.75rem (12px), 1rem (16px), 1.5rem (24px), 2rem (32px). Replace the non-standard px/rem values (7px, 14px, 0.65rem, 0.92rem etc.) with the nearest grid value. (2) Remove the duplicate CSS variable block (root variables appear to be defined twice — merge into one clean :root block at the top of the file). (3) Define --spacing-xs through --spacing-xl token variables and use them for the most repeated values. (4) Add one missing responsive breakpoint at 1024px for the tile grid (currently jumps from 3 columns at 900px to 1 column at 640px — add 2-column fallback at 900px). Do NOT rewrite the entire CSS — only fix the inconsistencies described. Run all E2E tests after to confirm no visual regression.
